title: Nexus V2 Canonical
purpose: Authoritative operating record for Nexus V2, the fractional business systems company, its modular build method, AI stack, marketing engine, client delivery model, and operator command center.
authority_rule: Explicit decisions by Nicolas override prior recommendations and assumptions.

golden_rule.title: Truth Before Comfort
golden_rule.rule: Never claim completion unless the work is actually complete, verified, usable, and matches the approved scope. Never hide uncertainty, partial failure, missing validation, blockers, or unfinished dependencies to make progress sound better than it is.
hard_rules: Do not say done, fixed, deployed, working, resolved, saved, updated, finished, or complete without direct evidence supporting that exact claim.
A successful tool call does not automatically prove the user-visible outcome succeeded.
Partial work must be labeled accurately.
If required work remains, status cannot be Complete.
If required production behavior has not been verified, status cannot be Complete.
If known defects affect required behavior, status cannot be Complete.
Do not substitute optimism for evidence. 'Should work' and 'works' are different claims.
Never hide failures, omitted scope, or unresolved dependencies.
When blocked, state the blocker, impact, and exact next action.
Accuracy outranks reassurance, speed, appearance of progress, or the desire to please Nicolas.
complete_requires: Known limitations disclosed and compatible with acceptance criteria

delivery_target.target: Production-ready Nexus V2 in less than 8 weeks
delivery_target.rule: The under-8-week target is real, but it never overrides the Golden Rule, security, acceptance criteria, or production verification.
acceleration_strategy: Premium AI models where they save meaningful time
Paid commercial tools when cheaper than custom ownership
Contractors and specialists for bounded work packets
Managed infrastructure where it reduces setup/maintenance
Automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and documentation
Strict module contracts to reduce rework
No silent scope expansion during Phase One

spend_to_accelerate_rule.principle: Nicolas is willing to spend money to shorten delivery when the spend has a clear speed, quality, reliability, or gross-margin benefit.
decision_test: Does it save meaningful calendar time?
Does it reduce implementation or maintenance risk?
Does it avoid building commodity infrastructure?
Does it preserve or improve the 70% gross-margin target?
Does it avoid unacceptable lock-in or licensing risk?
Can it be replaced later if economics change?
spend_to_accelerate_rule.rule: Do not choose the cheapest option if a paid option materially accelerates the build or improves reliability. Spend deliberately, not wastefully.

repository.old_nexus_policy: Old Nexus is reference-only. Pull specific approved pieces only when needed; never merge or inherit wholesale.

business.positioning: Nicolas is the product. AI is infrastructure and leverage behind the service, not the marketing billboard.
business.managed_service_boundary: Retainer covers continuity, monitoring, support, minor adjustments and system stewardship. Work requiring planning, architecture, multiple work sessions, or threatening a major delivery becomes separately scoped project work.

marketing_engine.goal: Automated and outsourced customer acquisition engine feeding qualified opportunities to Nicolas.

build_method.rule: No single AI owns the whole build.
build_method.autonomous_worker_directive: Workers continue autonomously through their entire assigned scope; after each subtask they proceed to the next incomplete item, do not stop for reversible low-risk decisions, document a blocker and continue other independent work, checkpoint valid work at meaningful milestones, and only stop when acceptance criteria are satisfied, all remaining work is genuinely blocked, or the platform ends execution.
build_method.checkpoint_rule: Commit valid incremental work at meaningful milestones so another worker can resume from the last verified checkpoint.
build_method.model_allocation: Capability first; provider second. Model assignments are preferences, not blockers. If a provider/model is quota-limited, route work to another qualified model rather than pausing.

reuse_rule.title: Research Before Build
required_record: Reason custom code is still needed

ai_stack.revenue_rule: Only use provider/model routes for customer monetization after commercial customer-facing use is verified.
ai_stack.gateway: Apps should call Nexus AI Gateway instead of individual providers where practical.
ai_stack.customer_metering: Track wholesale cost, retail credits/price, gross profit, and gross margin per request/job.
ai_stack.development_goal: Reduce current roughly $500/month GPT + Claude + Grok development subscription spend where capability can be preserved or improved.

build_phase_strategy.subscriptions: Keep current ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok subscriptions during the accelerated Nexus V2 build; do not optimize them away until workload evidence supports replacement.
build_phase_strategy.programmatic_workers: Add aggregator/API capacity for autonomous Nexus workers launched from the command center.

plugsky.role: High-priority candidate for high-volume/routine autonomous build work if current API, flat-rate/fair-use, automation, concurrency, reliability and terms are verified.
plugsky.status: UNVERIFIED — must be verified before dependency or Revenue Bullpen approval.
plugsky.test_plan: Run representative Nexus jobs through Plugsky and OpenRouter and compare completion quality, latency, retries, effective cost and reliability.

openrouter.role: Programmatic specialist/frontier/fallback pool and immediate production-capable gateway candidate.
openrouter.strategy: Use selectively rather than routing all build workload through expensive frontier models.

build_phase_strategy.routing: Nexus AI Gateway chooses by capability, quality, effective cost, latency, availability, privacy/commercial constraints and fallback health; do not hard-code a provider.
build_phase_strategy.optimization_priority: During the <8-week build, optimize primarily for calendar time and reliability; spend deliberately when it materially accelerates delivery.

ai_stack.worker8_priority_directive: Worker 8 must explicitly verify Plugsky current official API/pricing/fair-use/automation/concurrency/commercial terms and benchmark Plugsky versus OpenRouter for Nexus build workloads. Do not rely on prior research as current verified truth.

nicolas_command_center.entry: Small low-visibility operator link known to Nicolas
nicolas_command_center.security: Real sign-in and authorization are mandatory; obscurity is not security.

worker_control.goal: Allow Nicolas to launch and supervise Nexus API/agent workers from the private command center rather than manually opening consumer AI chats.
worker_control.orchestration: Nexus checks dependencies, creates/loads a work packet, ensures the assigned branch/context/permissions/budget, routes through the AI Gateway, executes, checkpoints commits, tests/reviews, and reports status.
worker_control.continuation: If an execution session ends before acceptance criteria are satisfied, Nexus should be able to continue from the last verified checkpoint/handoff.
worker_control.model_failover: Preferred models may have qualified fallbacks when quota or provider availability prevents execution.
worker_control.merge_policy: Merge remains gated and must not be an unrestricted autonomous worker action.
worker_control.implementation_boundary: Durable one-click execution should use API/agent workers through Nexus AI Gateway, not UI automation of consumer ChatGPT/Claude/Grok apps.
worker_control.mvp_priority: P0 — build the smallest real supervisor/control slice first: persistent work packet, API worker launch, checkpoint, execution-end detection, acceptance-state check, automatic continuation, budget cap, genuine-blocker stop, and mobile status/control.
worker_control.target_first_slice: Prioritize functional worker supervision over broad dashboard polish.

phase_one.rule: No Phase One workstream merges directly into nexus-v2. Control Tower reconciles contracts before Phase Two.

current_model_state.note: Workers 1, 2, 7 and 8 are currently running on ChatGPT/GPT-5.6 Sol. Grok is temporarily over its usage limit. Do not interrupt active workers solely to rebalance model families.
current_model_state.routing_rule: Use the best qualified available model; do not wait for Grok quota to reset.

priority_override.decision: Accelerate worker supervision and Nicolas Command & Control immediately.
priority_override.reason: Manual 'Go' turns in consumer ChatGPT are creating operator friction and slowing the <8-week build.
priority_override.note: Worker 9 and Worker 13 may begin before all other Phase One contracts are complete. They must consume current canonical contracts, isolate reversible implementation, and raise Architecture Change Requests for shared-contract conflicts.

v1_salvage.policy: V1 is a donor system, not the V2 foundation. Phase One is inspection/provenance/classification only; no V1 code migration.
v1_salvage.method: Audit by capability and branch lineage; classify KEEP AS-IS / ADAPT / REBUILD / REFERENCE ONLY / DISCARD; compare commodity V1 implementations against Worker 2 external reuse research before migration.
v1_salvage.acceptance_rule: Worker 12 cannot claim Complete while any required acceptance criterion or independently executable audit work remains.
